endpoint.redirects: never follow; documented task303 decoded in-place with Location ignored
endpoint.base_path_disposition: Published Swagger basePath /client/v2 is descriptive. Official URL table/native SDK select /servers/v2 as actual endpoint. Operation paths appended once.

request.mapping_source: dedicated/methods_generated.go, client.go, wire.go, query.go; generated from explicit pinned lifecycle selection
request.auth: AccountClient uses account IAM; ProjectClient uses project IAM. Both explicitly documented; no fallback/reauth on403.
request.scope: Immutable caller view; exact resource/service/location/plan/image/task ref kind, service/generation/scope/endpoint checked. Project fields cannot collide with immutable project scope except explicit UpdateResourceProject.
request.parameters: Every source body/query/path field represented by generated DTOs. Nil omitted; explicit false/empty/zero values survive. Optional[T] distinguishes omitted/null/value for published nullable fields. Query and body errors go through core finalizer before credentials/I/O.
request.partitions: Published literal-* and native typed map are explicit PartitionConfiguration variants; no untyped request payload or retry fallback. Native evidence pinned separately.
request.effect: Billing calculations are safe reads despite POST/PUT and never treated as orders; resource billing/order calls mutate.
request.sensitive_input: Private encoder reveals protected fields only when forming HTTP body; diagnostic/JSON formatting redacts.

response.field_mapping: All properties and composed allOf fields preserved; integer/decimal numbers exact, no float64/currency-unit conversion. Provider epochs remain exact integers. Declared schemaless results remain ProtectedJSON. Nullable fields preserve null. Source literal wildcard fields are retained; partition native map has direct SDK proof.
response.union: core.DoJSONStatus selects HTTP202 generic ResponseBaseModel independently from typed200/201 schema, including identical payloads. Reply.HTTPStatus reports exact status; typed data is not readiness. Task303 is decoded without following Location. DeleteCustomOSImage has a direct, non-envelope source DTO and does not require task_id.
response.resource_ref: Extract trustworthy task ID before later decoding. Scan all resource result IDs before typed field decoding; preserve independent trusted IDs after malformed/duplicate/foreign rows. Existing GET/PUT/PATCH refs must match UUID; POST create may return new IDs. Source project_uuid checked for project view. Directory refs use same call scope/endpoint. Injected ref fields ignored. Existing exact caller-supplied parent chains are cloned/preserved; a present primary_uuid must match an existing parent. Without an explicitly scoped parent, primary_uuid remains metadata and no parent owner scope is inferred.
response.project_transfer: Project-scoped explicit transfer retains original request ref/receipt and typed target project metadata, verifies target UUID/project, and does not adopt a new scope or retain a stale Data.Ref. Account-scoped refs remain account view identities.

errors.401: unauthenticated; no implicit auth mode change
errors.404: not_found for reads, task absence is not completion or proof of nonapplication
errors.5xx_or_transport_mutation: unknown_outcome with original exact refs; mutation never replayed
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error with accepted Receipt and already trustworthy task/resource IDs
errors.message: Fixed SDK errors; raw provider error bodies discarded

retry: Bounded safe reads/calculations; mutations one attempt, no replay

wait.meaning: Named provider fields only: stable power on/off, resource active/non-renewing, OS reinstall flag0 with no processing. Not application readiness, reboot-cycle proof, or proof of unknown mutation authorship.
wait.limitations: Task status is free-form and terminal states/result schemas are unconfirmed; exact GetTask is supported but no task terminal waiter. HTTP202 order without resource IDs cannot bind resource wait until exact IDs are supplied/returned; no name lookup/adoption.
wait.mandatory_fields: Power requires present non-null power_state and target_power_state (stable target explicitly empty); OS requires present non-null reinstall and is_processing (installed0 plus explicit false). Missing/null returns ProtocolError; unknown raw state retained with classification unknown.
wait.classification: Status uses pending/succeeded/failed/unknown for documented field states; classification does not substitute for the explicitly selected Wait goal.

recovery.availability: Dedicated explicit handles observe only exact refs. Unknown receipts stay indeterminate and never replay. Root Resume not claimed.

timeout: Shared core call budget, bounded read retries and response bytes; operations.Handle WaitTimeout/PollInterval plus caller context.
